description:
## Approved plan task A3

- **Functional scope/files:** `web/delivery.ex`, `web/response.ex`, `web_bridge.ex` and Channels status-map conversion. Reuse existing Outgoing.routing_context propagation and config-scoped connection helpers unchanged unless a concrete gap is demonstrated. Provide the BO descriptor, response mapping and temporary legacy descriptor for unmigrated callers.
- **Behavior:** preserve status intent, full-content streaming, final metadata and error fallback. Retain stable correlation through routing/Agent/persistence/Channels hops. Keep opaque web transport context out of generic domain decisions and out of public payloads.
- **Tests before implementation:** round-trip message → Incoming → Outgoing → status/final delivery through real Channels API; a test must catch the current status-map metadata loss. Verify result metadata cannot override the trusted destination, unknown descriptors fail safely, other providers keep their existing shapes, and BO consumers receive only their session's events.
- **Branches:** status-only, stream replacement, completion with/without persistence ID, pipeline rejection, dispatch failure, missing context, malformed descriptor, duplicate fallback source, two simultaneous sessions, two config-scoped outgoing destinations, invalid scoped config ID and BO without config. Verify the status-upsert map preserves the new opaque context after existing connector selection.
- **Mocking:** actual PubSub with unique topics; external model only where pipeline execution is necessary.
- **Documentation:** semantic response table, wire descriptor, correlation and delivery guarantees; mark legacy compatibility removal task B4.
- **Action reuse:** local-only transport transformation and publication, reusing existing `:upsert_message`/`:deliver_outgoing`. No new message persistence or duplicate agent execution.
- **Done:** the shared contract works end-to-end while the old BO path still works during migration.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.3 (A2).
Blocks zaq-pkd.5 (B1).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.

comments.text: Implemented normalized semantic delivery with serializable trusted Delivery references in routing_context.attributes.web_delivery, preserving existing Outgoing routing context and Channels status-map conversion. WebBridge now maps final/status/stream events to versioned Responses and adapter event names, rejects malformed descriptors, ignores forged metadata destinations, isolates PubSub topics, and retains legacy tuples only when no descriptor exists. Config-scoped connection helpers remain unchanged. Public payloads are allowlisted; finalization/private execution context is not projected. Action reuse: local-only transport mapping/publication reuses existing :deliver_outgoing, :upsert_message, PubSub, Outgoing routing context and connector selection; no new persistence, Agent execution, Action or tool. Tests cover message→Incoming→Outgoing→final/status round trip, full-content stream replacement, trusted-destination precedence, session isolation, malformed descriptors, and legacy compatibility. Validation: 28 focused tests + 1 property, Channels API 98 tests, Engine routing/API 97 tests + 1 property all pass; mix q and diff check pass. Non-failing :license_manager warning remains. Beadwork remote sync is still blocked by the environment SSH key.

title: [830] A3 — Implement normalized delivery and preserve transport context across the pipeline
